description: A video-based, goal-directed laparoscopic basic-skills simulation curriculum developed by the Lübeck surgical-training team for novice surgical residents to practise independently over a structured six-week period.
title: Lübeck Toolbox (LTB) Curriculum

description: LUCA is a browser-based office-simulation and assessment environment developed by Sabrina Ludwig and colleagues, providing simulated office tools, authoring of authentic work scenarios, embedded assessments, and activity logging for business education.
title: LUCA browser-based office simulation

description: LUDIA is a browser-based, private, multilingual AI thought-partner tool developed by Stark et al.
title: LUDIA

description: Lumen Learning's online statistics courseware replaces or supplements textbooks with segmented multimedia content, interactive practice, study supports, and instructor-facing engagement and intervention tools.
title: Lumen One Introduction to Statistics

description: Philips Lumify is a handheld ultrasound system comprising a transducer, mobile-device application, and cloud-connected imaging workflow for acquiring and sharing diagnostic images.
title: Lumify handheld ultrasound system

description: LumiNote is an instructor-facing Unity3D and Meta Quest 3 VR system developed by Danxuan Liang and colleagues that uses GPT-4o and Whisper to convert spoken teaching intent into reviewable spatial annotations, demonstrations, and language support for stage-lighting education.
title: LumiNote

description: A self-directed online professional-training programme run by Lung Foundation Australia to develop clinicians’ knowledge and skills for evidence-based pulmonary rehabilitation assessment and delivery.
title: Lung Foundation Australia Pulmonary Rehabilitation Online Training Program

description: Lungsim is a web-based interactive pulmonary physiology and ICU simulation program developed for medical students and pulmonary, critical-care, and anesthesiology trainees.
title: lungsim
